ctx.x: as they came on. Sue Hoye, a real favorite, proved that she will retain -- retains her hold on the crowds. Her singing numbers were pleasing.

"Consuela Harris, a newcomer, was pleasing in her dance numbers. She is a real beauty, And Gertrude Saunders is found a clever singing and dancing comedienne. One will have travel a long way to find a comedian who can top that fellow, Billy Mitchell. Miss Hunter has assembled a line of beautiful and smooth dancing chorines, eight in all, that (unintelligible) -- that's it, should be execute her routine in perfect time and rhythm. They're beautifully costumed in keeping with the tone of the place.
"Buck Clayton and his Harlem Gentlemen Orchestra supply the tantalizing music for the patrons as well as the floor reviews. Food and drinks are the highest quality."
